channel.title: IGRS — Intel Grid Research Station
channel.description: Cybersecurity, OSINT and digital-forensics intelligence for India's frontline defenders — threat intel, investigation playbooks and free tools.

item.title: Digital Evidence in India: How to Preserve It So It Holds Up in Court
item.description: A practical guide to preserving digital evidence in India so it survives court scrutiny: hashing and integrity, chain of custody, the Section 63 BSA certificate (formerly 65B), and the mistakes that get electronic evidence thrown out.

item.title: How to Trace a Phone Number in India: A Lawful OSINT Guide
item.description: What you can — and cannot — legally learn from an Indian phone number using OSINT. A responsible, investigator-focused guide to caller-ID, public records, social-media pivots, the legal process for subscriber data, and the privacy limits that matter.

item.title: VPNs Explained: How They Work, India's CERT-In Rules & the Global Censorship Picture
item.description: A plain-English guide to VPNs: how they actually work, whether they are legal in India, what the CERT-In 2022 directive requires, and where VPNs are restricted around the world — with clear diagrams and no jargon.

item.title: Quishing: Why QR Code Phishing Is Exploding in India
item.description: QR code phishing — 'quishing' — is surging in India, riding on the country's UPI QR habit. Learn how the scam works, the red flags, how to stay safe, and how investigators analyse a malicious QR safely.

item.title: Why India's Biggest Data Breaches Start with Insecure APIs
item.description: From Aadhaar to ICMR to consumer apps, India's largest data breaches share one root cause: insecure APIs and exposed endpoints. A clear breakdown of the failure patterns, the OWASP API risks behind them, and how to defend and test responsibly.

item.title: Innefu Labs Raises $30M Series B — India's Sovereign-AI Push
item.description: New Delhi national-security AI firm Innefu Labs has raised USD 30 million (about Rs 286 crore) in a Series B round led by Panthera Growth Partners, with plans for an Agentic AI platform, a Physical AI robotics wing, global expansion and an eventual IPO. What the deal means for India's sovereign deep-tech sector.

item.title: How to Analyze Email Headers: Trace the Sender & Spot Spoofing
item.description: A practical, step-by-step guide to reading raw email headers — how to extract them, follow the Received relay chain to the originating IP, interpret SPF/DKIM/DMARC, and spot spoofing. Includes a worked example and a free in-browser analyzer.

item.title: FortiBleed: 30,000+ Fortinet Firewalls Hijacked — India Is 60% of the Government Hits
item.description: FortiBleed is a live credential-harvesting campaign that has compromised tens of thousands of internet-facing Fortinet firewalls and VPN gateways worldwide — and India accounts for over 60% of the government devices in the attacker's database. What happened, which CVEs are being exploited, the forensic traces, and an immediate defensive playbook for Indian organisations.

item.title: CERT-In's 12-Hour Patch Rule: India's Answer to AI-Speed Attacks (2026)
item.description: CERT-In's new 38-page blueprint urges Indian organisations to patch known-exploited, internet-facing vulnerabilities within 12 hours as AI collapses the time attackers need to find and exploit flaws. The full risk-based remediation timeline, what it means for Indian security teams, and a practical compliance playbook.

item.title: Kali365: The Microsoft 365 Phishing Kit That Bypasses MFA (FBI Warning, 2026)
item.description: The FBI has warned about Kali365, a Phishing-as-a-Service kit that hijacks Microsoft 365 accounts by abusing the OAuth device code flow — bypassing MFA without stealing a password. How it works, why it defeats MFA, the forensic traces it leaves, and a defensive playbook for Indian organisations and users.

item.title: Telegram Ban & NEET 2026 Paper-Leak Panic — What Actually Happened
item.description: Why India blocked Telegram until 22 June 2026 ahead of the NEET-UG re-exam — the Section 69A order, the message-edit fabrication trick, the paper-leak fraud economy, what students and families should do, and the legal framework.

item.title: Southeast Asia Scam Compounds & the India Connection 2026
item.description: How transnational scam compounds in Myanmar, Cambodia and Laos drive pig-butchering fraud, traffic Indians into forced cyber-slavery, and the 2026 global enforcement response — DOJ seizures, OFAC sanctions, UN findings and India's countermeasures.

item.title: ICAI Data Breach 2026 — Alleged Examiners Portal Leak (Unverified)
item.description: Threat-intelligence analysis of the alleged June 2026 ICAI examiners portal breach claimed by actor 'zowico'. Unverified claim, conflicting figures, impact, legal context (IT Act, BNS, DPDP) and what CAs, students and examiners should do.

item.title: Deepfake Financial Fraud in India 2026 — Voice Cloning, Scams & the Law
item.description: How AI deepfakes and voice cloning are driving financial fraud in India in 2026 — the scale, the attack playbook, executive impersonation, the new IT takedown rules, defensive guidance and the IT Act / BNS / DPDP legal framework.

item.description: How fraudsters abuse WhatsApp Business API for phishing, scam campaigns, and mass fraud in India. Investigation methodology, Meta legal process, evidence preservation, and applicable law sections.

item.description: Step-by-step guide to using TAFCOP (Telecom Analytics for Fraud Management and Consumer Protection) for cybercrime investigation, SIM verification, and telecom fraud cases in India.

item.description: Complete social media OSINT methodology for Indian investigators. Facebook, Instagram, Twitter, LinkedIn, WhatsApp investigation techniques, account recovery analysis, and evidence preservation.

item.description: Complete ransomware incident response guide for Indian organizations. Immediate steps, CERT-In reporting, forensic investigation, legal obligations under DPDP Act, and recovery planning.

item.title: Phishing Email Investigation — Complete Guide for India 2026

item.description: Step-by-step OSINT methodology for tracing UPI mule accounts in India. Phone number intelligence, UPI VPA analysis, bank account tracing, social media correlation, and money trail reconstruction.
